cyfun.title: NIS2 & CyFun: <accent>are you concerned?</accent>
cyfun.lead: The NIS2 directive targets thousands of Belgian companies, SMEs and subcontractors included. In Belgium, the official framework is CyFun, published by the CCB.
cyfun.hook: The Basic level already covers ~82 % of common attacks. The best starting point for an SME.
cyfun.deadlineText: In force since 18 October 2024. Anticipating reduces the risk.
cyfun.fine: Non-compliance: administrative fines and personal liability of management.

diagnostic.title: A clear gap report, domain by domain
diagnostic.text: Every CyFun requirement is measured, not guessed. A maturity level per domain (governance, access, network, detection, continuity) aggregated into a global score.

data.title: Based in Liège, your data stays in Belgium
data.text: No offshore hosting. Infrastructure, backups, exchanges: everything stays in Belgium and in the EU, with a contact on site.

honesty.title: In full transparency
honesty.text: CyFun certification is issued by BELAC-accredited bodies, not by Smidjan. Our role: audit, gap analysis, remediation and preparation for the verification. We do not just note the gaps: we fix them.

step1.title: Scoping & self-assessment
step1.description: Perimeter, critical assets, CyFun self-assessment, together with your teams.

step2.title: Gap analysis & remediation
step2.description: We measure the gap to the target level and fix it, by order of risk priority.

step3.title: Support for the CCB verification
step3.description: We prepare the file up to the verification by the accredited body.

step4.title: Continuous follow-up
step4.description: We maintain your posture over time, not just on the day itself.
